required_inputs.requirement: Transcript-linked HGVS c. or equivalent exact reference/alternate nucleotide change, with protein consequence if available; preserve supplied identifier and verify reference allele
Exact accession.version and mutant sequence or variant source; relevant flanking sequence and any linked variants/haplotype
Which mutant allele to silence, whether/how much wild-type KRAS must be spared, and whether other KRAS variants should be spared
Cell/tumor model, expressed transcript isoforms, genotype/zygosity and relevant allele-expression information when available
Mutant knockdown endpoint and acceptable wild-type suppression under specified dose/time/chemistry/delivery conditions

future_evidence: Exact mutant and matched wild-type site mappings and mismatch positions
Both-strand transcriptome and seed specificity including HRAS/NRAS and related/pseudogene transcripts
A mismatch-discrimination assessment with demonstrated applicability; ordinary perfect-match potency scores are not an allele-selectivity model
Sequence/chemistry-linked mutant and wild-type experimental response under intended conditions
warnings: Shared-arm candidates are not mutation-selective designs
No mutant FASTA, hypothetical variant or mutation-selective candidate generated
